name: cline-console
description: Local terminal control plane for the Cline VS Code extension
author: bvrznski

cline-console.taskScanner.enabled.description: Enable completion scanning and same-task continuation policies for all workspaces.

cline-console.taskScanner.terminalStabil.description: Seconds a Cline completion must remain terminal before the scanner evaluates it.

cline-console.taskScanner.completionConf.description: Minimum evidence-based completion confidence percentage that accepts a verification pass even when it made justified implementation changes.

cline-console.taskScanner.maxCompletionV.description: Maximum completion-verification requests before accepting a completion that has no explicit incomplete-work indicators, preventing endless verification loops.

cline-console.taskScanner.cleanupTermina.description: After successful queued tasks and before YOLO restarts, retry disposal of idle workspace shells and close clean task-opened workspace tabs. Preserve busy, dirty, unknown, and [keep]-prefixed resources.

cline-console.taskScanner.sudoZenityProm.description: Show a Zenity warning when a running queued task starts an interactive sudo command. Password entry remains exclusively in the VS Code terminal.

cline-console.taskScanner.interTaskDelay.description: Seconds to wait after a completed queue task before dispatching the next task.

cline-console.taskScanner.detectIncomple.description: Keep a task active when its completion report or task progress declares unfinished work.

cline-console.taskScanner.maxUnchangedCo.description: Maximum consecutive STOP correction rounds that may return another incomplete completion claim without detected implementation activity before the queue item fails. Implementation activity resets this streak.

cline-console.taskScanner.detectTestTime.description: Keep a task active when a recognized test command timed out without a successful same-scope rerun.

cline-console.taskScanner.implementAudit.description: For audit tasks, request implementation of concrete recommendations in the same task before completion.

cline-console.taskScanner.requirePostImp.description: Require audit remediation to produce a durable post-remediation report with validation and residual risk.

cline-console.taskScanner.verifyCompleti.description: Require a final same-thread criteria verification; repeat it only when the verification pass makes implementation changes.

cline-console.taskScanner.reflective.description: After a queued task completes, request a same-thread Markdown reflection about implementation difficulties, blockers, tradeoffs, and lessons; the response is also retained in history.

cline-console.taskScanner.restartOnYoloF.description: Ask the daemon to recycle the exact registered VS Code extension host and reopen its workspace after a detected YOLO MODE three-consecutive-mistakes failure; incidents and outcomes are recorded in SQLite.

cline-console.taskScanner.detectStuckLoo.description: Detect when the LLM makes repeated completion claims without implementation activity and send a control request to break out of the loop.

cline-console.taskScanner.maxStuckLoopRo.description: Maximum consecutive completion claims without implementation activity before triggering a stuck loop detection and correction message.

cline-console.taskScanner.waitForLmStudi.description: Hold queue recovery and new task dispatch after startup until the configured LM Studio endpoint reports at least one loaded model through /v1/models.

cline-console.taskScanner.lmStudioHost.description: Host used by the queue's LM Studio readiness gate.

cline-console.taskScanner.lmStudioPort.description: TCP port used by the queue's LM Studio readiness gate.

cline-console.taskScanner.singleQueuePer.description: Permit only one cline-console queue task per loaded LM Studio model. Resuming a competing owned task pauses its queue and presses Cancel in the running Cline thread without clearing that thread.

scripts.verify:release: npm test && npm audit && npm pack --dry-run && vsce ls --tree
